name: ListenBrainz API
summary: Open listening-history database: site-wide and per-artist listening statistics, public user listens and MBID-keyed music metadata.
description: ListenBrainz is the MetaBrainz scrobbling service. Its public endpoints serve site-wide top artists, releases, release groups and recordings per time range, listening-activity series, per-artist listeners, any user's public listens and artist metadata keyed by MusicBrainz IDs. Several endpoints (for example popularity and some recommendation calls) now answer 401 without a user token.

auth.notes: Public statistics, metadata and user-listens endpoints worked without a token. A user token (sent as 'Authorization: Token <token>') is needed to submit listens and for some endpoints, e.g. /popularity/top-recordings-for-artist returned 401 without one.

rate_limit.summary: Documented: never more than one call per second per client. Responses carry X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset headers (observed limit 30 with a roughly 10 second window).

endpoints.summary: Top artists across all users for a time range
Site-wide listen counts bucketed over a time range
Artist metadata and external links by MusicBrainz ID
Public listen history of a user

license.name: See the ListenBrainz data page; not re-confirmed

coverage.temporal: Continuously updated; statistics ranges this_week, this_month, this_year, all_time and more

agent_notes: Identify artists, releases and recordings by MusicBrainz IDs and join to the musicbrainz record for names and relationships. Statistics endpoints take a range parameter and return a payload object with from_ts/to_ts (Unix seconds). Keep to one call per second and watch X-RateLimit-Remaining.
caveats: Some endpoints now require a user token (observed 401 on /popularity/top-recordings-for-artist with an explanatory message about AI scrapers).
Statistics are precomputed and refreshed periodically, see last_updated in each payload.
The old api.listenbrainz.org/openapi.json returned 410 Gone; a community OpenAPI file exists only in a third-party repository.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a token.
